name: Sea-level rise (IPCC AR6)
summary: Applies published IPCC AR6 relative sea-level projections to coastal point data. Consumes projections; does not produce them.

hostCapabilities.note: A projection is keyed by site, scenario, workflow, year and quantile, with many rows per site. The host imports points, rasters and graphs only, and PortType is a closed union, so this pack cannot be admitted until the host adds a tabular port and importer. See fieldwork docs/experiments/47-sea-level-pack.md.

discovery.note: Out of scope by decision: the practitioner has already obtained the dataset. Which workflow, scenario and dataset family they chose is recorded on import, not chosen here.

acquisition.note: Impossible in a browser for this data. The tide-gauge sample store alone is 38.42 GB of zarr and the summary files are NetCDF.

extraction.note: scripts/extract-projection.py, run outside the application where xarray can read NetCDF. Writes a long-format CSV and a provenance record.

import.note: slr_extract_import. Blocked on the host tabular port.

application.note: slr_site_assignment and slr_threshold_comparison. Both are consumers of published projections, never producers.

dataSources.name: IPCC AR6 Sea Level Projections
requiredCitations: Fox-Kemper, B., et al. 2021: Ocean, Cryosphere and Sea Level Change. In Climate Change 2021: The Physical Science Basis. IPCC AR6 WG1, Chapter 9. doi:10.1017/9781009157896.011
Kopp, R. E., Garner, G. G., et al. 2023. The Framework for Assessing Changes To Sea-Level (FACTS) v1.0. Geoscientific Model Development 16, 7461-7489. doi:10.5194/gmd-16-7461-2023
